segments.text: an oil or a liquid, at some stage you will have to dissolve it in a solvent.
segments.zh: 油状物还是液体，在某个阶段你都得把它溶解在溶剂里。

segments.text: Whether you need it as a solution so that you can run a reaction,
segments.zh: 无论你需要把它配成溶液是为了进行反应，

segments.text: or perhaps a chromatographic purification,
segments.zh: 还是为了进行色谱纯化，

segments.text: when you're done, you will need to remove the solvent
segments.zh: 完成之后，你都需要除去溶剂，

segments.text: in order to isolate the purer compound.
segments.zh: 以便分离出更纯的化合物。

segments.text: Luckily, a very useful piece of laboratory equipment
segments.zh: 幸运的是，有一种非常有用的实验室设备，

segments.text: called a rotary evaporator, or a rotabap,
segments.zh: 叫做旋转蒸发仪（rotavap），

segments.text: was designed for just this use.
segments.zh: 就是专门为此设计的。

segments.text: While rotabaps are very easy to use,
segments.zh: 虽然旋转蒸发仪很容易使用，

segments.text: there are a few general rules of operation that you will need to follow.
segments.zh: 但还是有几条基本操作规则需要你遵守。

segments.text: This video will demonstrate the correct use of a rotabap.
segments.zh: 本视频将演示旋转蒸发仪的正确使用方法。

segments.text: While rotabaps come in a variety of different styles,
segments.zh: 旋转蒸发仪有多种不同的样式，

segments.text: they are all made up of the same fundamental pieces.
segments.zh: 但它们都由相同的基本部件组成。

segments.text: These are a vacuum line to reduce the pressure inside of the whole rotabap system.
segments.zh: 这些部件包括：一条真空管路，用来降低整个旋转蒸发仪系统内部的压力。

segments.text: Remember, solvents boil at lower temperatures under reduced atmosphere.
segments.zh: 记住，在减压下溶剂的沸点会降低。

segments.text: A hot water bath used to warm the flask containing your dissolved material.
segments.zh: 一个热水浴，用来加热装有你所溶解物料的烧瓶。

segments.text: Evaporation is a cooling process,
segments.zh: 蒸发是一个吸热降温的过程，

segments.text: so you need to add a little heat to evaporate the solvent.
segments.zh: 所以你需要加一点热才能使溶剂蒸发。

segments.text: A nice clean bump trap to which you will attach your flask.
segments.zh: 一个洁净的防暴沸球，你的烧瓶就接在它上面。

segments.text: This useful piece of glassware will prevent any of your material
segments.zh: 这个有用的玻璃器件可以防止你的任何物料

segments.text: from ending up inside the rest of the rotabap.
segments.zh: 跑到旋转蒸发仪的其他部分里去。

segments.text: A rotary motor that spins your flask
segments.zh: 一个旋转电机，用来转动你的烧瓶，

segments.text: and spreads the solvent out on the flask walls.
segments.zh: 使溶剂在烧瓶壁上铺展开。

segments.text: This creates more surface area and allows for rapid evaporation of the solvent.
segments.zh: 这样能增大表面积，使溶剂快速蒸发。

segments.text: A cooled condenser to condense the solvent vapor from your flask
segments.zh: 一个冷却的冷凝管，用来冷凝来自烧瓶的溶剂蒸气，

segments.text: and a receiver to collect the condensed solvent.
segments.zh: 还有一个接收瓶，用来收集冷凝下来的溶剂。

segments.text: If all goes well, the solvent that starts out in your flask ends up in the receiver
segments.zh: 如果一切顺利，原本在烧瓶里的溶剂最终会进入接收瓶，

segments.text: while your material stays put in your flask.
segments.zh: 而你的物料则留在烧瓶里。

segments.text: Rotabap operation is very simple,
segments.zh: 旋转蒸发仪的操作非常简单，

segments.text: but there are a few guidelines that you need to follow
segments.zh: 但有几条准则你需要遵守，

segments.text: to avoid some potentially painful mistakes.
segments.zh: 以免犯下一些可能很惨痛的错误。

segments.text: Rule number one, tie back your hair and avoid loose sleeves.
segments.zh: 第一条规则：把头发扎起来，不要穿宽松的袖子。

segments.text: The rotary motor on the rotabap is a potential safety hazard.
segments.zh: 旋转蒸发仪上的旋转电机是一个潜在的安全隐患。

segments.text: Take care not to lean too close or dangle your hair, clothing, or jewelry near the motor.
segments.zh: 注意不要靠得太近，也不要让头发、衣物或首饰垂到电机附近。

segments.text: Otherwise, you may end up saying a painful goodbye to some precious material,
segments.zh: 否则，你可能会痛苦地失去一些宝贵的东西，

segments.text: maybe even your scalp.
segments.zh: 甚至可能是你的头皮。

segments.text: Rule number two, never fill your flask more than half full.
segments.zh: 第二条规则：烧瓶装液绝不要超过一半。

segments.text: When preparing to use the rotabap,
segments.zh: 准备使用旋转蒸发仪时，

segments.text: you never want to fill your round bottom flask more than half full.
segments.zh: 圆底烧瓶里的液体绝不要超过一半。

segments.text: Even if you have a large volume of solution to concentrate,
segments.zh: 即使你有大量溶液需要浓缩，

segments.text: it will never save you time to overfill the flask.
segments.zh: 把烧瓶装得过满也绝不会帮你节省时间。

segments.text: It will most likely lead to an unfortunate and time-consuming problem called bumping.
segments.zh: 这很可能会导致一个麻烦又费时的问题，叫做暴沸。

segments.text: In other words, your material will take a trip to the bump trap.
segments.zh: 换句话说，你的物料会跑进防暴沸球里。

segments.text: This will require you to rinse the bump trap with solvent,
segments.zh: 这样你就得用溶剂冲洗防暴沸球，

segments.text: adding even more to the overall volume you need to concentrate.
segments.zh: 使需要浓缩的总体积变得更大。

segments.text: Rule number three, make sure there are no solids in the flask.
segments.zh: 第三条规则：确保烧瓶中没有固体。

segments.text: This includes stir bars.
segments.zh: 这包括搅拌子。

segments.text: They may seem harmless, but they can also lead to bumping.
segments.zh: 它们看起来可能无害，但也会导致暴沸。

segments.text: Rule number four, always use a clean bump trap.
segments.zh: 第四条规则：始终使用洁净的防暴沸球。

segments.text: Even when you're careful, bumping can happen.
segments.zh: 即使你很小心，暴沸也可能发生。

segments.text: Therefore, you should always thoroughly wash the bump trap
segments.zh: 因此，使用之前你都应该彻底清洗防暴沸球，

segments.text: and rinse it with solvent before you use it.
segments.zh: 并用溶剂冲洗。

segments.text: You never know what someone else may have left inside,
segments.zh: 你永远不知道别人可能在里面留下了什么，

segments.text: and you don't want it to end up mixed with your material.
segments.zh: 你也不希望那些东西混进你的物料里。

segments.text: But before you attach the bump trap or your flask to the rotabap,
segments.zh: 不过，在把防暴沸球或烧瓶接到旋转蒸发仪上之前，

segments.text: proceed to rule number five, cool the condenser and the receiver.
segments.zh: 先执行第五条规则：冷却冷凝管和接收瓶。

segments.text: Make sure that cold water is circulating through the condenser
segments.zh: 确保冷水在冷凝管中循环流动，

segments.text: and place the receiver in an ice bath.
segments.zh: 并把接收瓶放在冰浴中。

segments.text: Make sure that minimal solvent vapor makes it out of the rotabap
segments.zh: 确保只有极少量的溶剂蒸气离开旋转蒸发仪

segments.text: and into the vacuum line.
segments.zh: 进入真空管路。

segments.text: Now you are ready to put your half-filled,
segments.zh: 现在你可以把这个装液一半、

segments.text: solid-free flask on the rotabap.
segments.zh: 不含固体的烧瓶装到旋转蒸发仪上了。

segments.text: Attach your flask securely to the bump trap
segments.zh: 把烧瓶牢固地接到防暴沸球上，

segments.text: using a Keck clip and an adapter if necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时使用 Keck 夹和转接头。

segments.text: Rule number six, pull vacuum just a little bit
segments.zh: 第六条规则：先稍微抽一点真空，

segments.text: before spinning your flask.
segments.zh: 再转动烧瓶。

segments.text: After you attach your flask,
segments.zh: 接好烧瓶后，

segments.text: open the system up to a little bit of vacuum
segments.zh: 让系统抽一点点真空，

segments.text: and start the rotary motor.
segments.zh: 然后启动旋转电机。

segments.text: If you start the spinning first without the vacuum
segments.zh: 如果你在没有真空的情况下就先开始旋转，

segments.text: to hold everything in place,
segments.zh: 没有真空把各部件固定住，

segments.text: your flask and the bump trap might end up floating in the water bath.
segments.zh: 你的烧瓶和防暴沸球可能最后会漂在水浴里。

segments.text: Rule number seven,
segments.zh: 第七条规则：

segments.text: open the vacuum line slowly to start the evaporation.
segments.zh: 缓慢打开真空管路，开始蒸发。

segments.text: Watch your flask carefully to make sure that the bubbling is under control
segments.zh: 仔细观察烧瓶，确保鼓泡在控制之中，

segments.text: and reduce the vacuum if it looks like it is going too fast.
segments.zh: 如果看起来蒸发太快，就减小真空度。

segments.text: Opening the vacuum line too fast is another good way
segments.zh: 真空管路开得太快，也是

segments.text: to get your material to bump.
segments.zh: 让物料暴沸的另一个“好办法”。

segments.text: When you have achieved a stable rate of evaporation,
segments.zh: 蒸发速率稳定之后，

segments.text: lower the flask into the hot water bath.
segments.zh: 把烧瓶降入热水浴中。

segments.text: This will prevent the flask from icing up as it cools during evaporation,
segments.zh: 这样可以防止烧瓶在蒸发降温时结冰，

segments.text: and it will help the concentration to proceed at a reasonable rate.
segments.zh: 也有助于浓缩以合理的速度进行。

segments.text: Leave your flask on the rotabap until the sample becomes viscous
segments.zh: 把烧瓶一直留在旋转蒸发仪上，直到样品变得黏稠

segments.text: and sticks to the sides of the flask.
segments.zh: 并粘在烧瓶壁上。

segments.text: Depending on the viscosity of your material,
segments.zh: 根据物料的黏度不同，

segments.text: it may even form a ring around the middle of the flask.
segments.zh: 它甚至可能在烧瓶中部形成一圈。

segments.text: Solid material will most likely solidify when concentration is complete.
segments.zh: 固体物料在浓缩完成时很可能会凝固。

segments.text: Now you are ready to remove your flask.
segments.zh: 现在可以取下烧瓶了。

segments.text: To do so, turn off the rotary motor,
segments.zh: 为此，先关闭旋转电机，

segments.text: release the vacuum, and undo the ket clip.
segments.zh: 解除真空，然后松开 Keck 夹。

segments.text: You can proceed to a high vacuum pump
segments.zh: 如果需要除去样品中残留的少量溶剂，

segments.text: if you need to remove the small amount of solvent still in your sample.
segments.zh: 你可以接着用高真空泵处理。

segments.text: Let's quickly recap the rotabap rules that we have learned.
segments.zh: 我们来快速回顾一下学过的旋转蒸发仪规则。

segments.text: Rule number one, tie back your hair and avoid loose sleeves.
segments.zh: 第一条规则：把头发扎起来，不要穿宽松的袖子。

segments.text: Rule number two, never fill your flask more than half full.
segments.zh: 第二条规则：烧瓶装液绝不要超过一半。

segments.text: Rule number three, no solids should be in your flask.
segments.zh: 第三条规则：烧瓶中不应有固体。

segments.text: Rule number four, always use a clean bump trap.
segments.zh: 第四条规则：始终使用洁净的防暴沸球。

segments.text: Rule number five, cool the condenser and the receiver
segments.zh: 第五条规则：在接上烧瓶之前，

segments.text: before you attach your flask.
segments.zh: 先冷却冷凝管和接收瓶。

segments.text: Rule number six, pull vacuum just a little bit
segments.zh: 第六条规则：先稍微抽一点真空，

segments.text: before turning on the rotary motor to spin your flask.
segments.zh: 再打开旋转电机转动烧瓶。

segments.text: And rule number seven, open the vacuum line slowly
segments.zh: 第七条规则：缓慢打开真空管路，

segments.text: so that you don't cause your material to bump.
segments.zh: 以免使物料暴沸。

segments.text: Remember, this video is intended to help you prepare for lab
segments.zh: 记住，本视频旨在通过演示正确的实验技术，

segments.text: by providing a demonstration of the proper experimental technique.
segments.zh: 帮助你为实验做好准备。

segments.text: It is not intended as a replacement for reading your lab manual
segments.zh: 它并不能代替阅读你的实验手册

segments.text: or the supplementary material.
segments.zh: 或补充材料。

segments.text: In order to become a great experimentalist,
segments.zh: 要成为一名优秀的实验工作者，

segments.text: it is important that you understand both theory and technique.
segments.zh: 重要的是既要理解理论，也要掌握技术。

segments.text: Now it's your turn. Good luck.
segments.zh: 现在轮到你了。祝你好运。
